en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a mountainous forest valley with dense conifer woods. In the foreground and mid‑ground stand several large chalet‑style villas and hotel‑like buildings with steep gabled roofs, balconies, and small towers. More scattered houses and a church tower appear deeper in the valley. The scene suggests a central‑European spa or holiday resort town surrounded by wooded hills. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
